execution_scope_lock: Implement only the native startup curtain, bundle/resource wiring, presenter freshness seam, coordinator state wiring, focused tests, and acceptance telemetry described by the plan. No Android/AVD/runtime tuning, unlock-policy change, new polling loop, dependency update, unrelated refactor, or timeout reveal.
residual_accepted_risks: Existing one-second GameFrameTelemetry windowing may keep the splash visible slightly longer than the earliest possible TFT frame; this is accepted because it favors hiding startup noise over premature reveal.
A user-facing retry button is intentionally not included because current runtime restart semantics are outside this requested scope.

risks.mitigation: Capture current successfully presented source sequence at eligibility and require a strictly newer successfully completed source presentation before reveal.
risks.risk: GameActivity eligibility races a stale Android frame already in the host presenter.

risks.mitigation: Treat active MobileFREWebViewActivity as an explicit eligible manual-auth exception, still requiring fresh-frame proof.
risks.risk: Manual Riot login is hidden forever while waiting for GameActivity.

risks.mitigation: StartupSplashView stays topmost, captures pointer input, and owns first-responder focus until reveal.
risks.risk: Mouse/keyboard clicks pass through artwork to hidden Android/PIN.

risks.mitigation: Timeout is non-revealing by invariant; terminal failure remains covered with a native error.
risks.risk: A timeout exposes Android to avoid an apparent hang.

risks.mitigation: Curtain is installed before showWindow and constrained to the same root container through resize/fullscreen.
Consumer curtain applies only to officialTFT workload; ownedVulkanProbe retains existing diagnostic behavior.
risks.risk: Diagnostic owned-probe workflow is broken by waiting for TFT GameActivity.

risks.mitigation: Scope lock forbids AVD, emulator, PIN policy, renderer, package, dependency, and unrelated changes.
risks.risk: Feature grows into runtime/guest orchestration changes.

win_condition: TFTMAC's first visible content is the approved splash; Android/SystemUI/PIN startup remains hidden; normal reveal occurs only after exact TFT GameActivity eligibility plus a strictly newer successfully presented source frame; active Riot login is the only manual-auth exception; input is blocked while covered; failure remains covered; no guest/runtime configuration is changed.
